title: 3. Behavior and Segments — Offline
description: Compare two client-defined segments in synthetic historical profiles. Groups may overlap; A/B test names are not verified variant assignments.

list.name: a_platform
list.label: Group A · Platform
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT platform AS __text, platform AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: a_country
list.label: Group A · Country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT country AS __text, country AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: a_channel
list.label: Group A · Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT acquisition_channel AS __text, acquisition_channel AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: a_goal
list.label: Group A · Goal
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT onboarding_goal AS __text, onboarding_goal AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: a_flow
list.label: Group A · Flow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT flow AS __text, flow AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: a_test
list.label: Group A · Test name
list.query: SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ab_test AS __text, ab_test AS __value FROM offline_users WHERE NULLIF(ab_test, '') IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '(No test)' AS __text, '__no_test__' AS __value) choices ORDER BY __text

list.name: b_platform
list.label: Group B · Platform
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT platform AS __text, platform AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: b_country
list.label: Group B · Country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT country AS __text, country AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: b_channel
list.label: Group B · Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT acquisition_channel AS __text, acquisition_channel AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: b_goal
list.label: Group B · Goal
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT onboarding_goal AS __text, onboarding_goal AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: b_flow
list.label: Group B · Flow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT flow AS __text, flow AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: b_test
list.label: Group B · Test name
list.query: SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ab_test AS __text, ab_test AS __value FROM offline_users WHERE NULLIF(ab_test, '') IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '(No test)' AS __text, '__no_test__' AS __value) choices ORDER BY __text

panels.title: Group A vs B — first-day behavior
panels.description: Synthetic offline profiles. The groups may overlap; these are selected segments, not verified experiment variants. Empty groups have no average or share.

targets.rawSql: SELECT g.group_name AS "Group", COUNT(u.user_id)::integer AS "Users", ROUND(AVG(u.ai_edits_first_day), 2)::double precision AS "Mean first-day edits", ROUND(AVG(u.photos_imported), 2)::double precision AS "Mean photos imported", COUNT(u.user_id) FILTER (WHERE u.push_opt_in = 'yes')::integer AS "Push opt-in users", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(u.user_id) FILTER (WHERE u.push_opt_in = 'yes') / NULLIF(COUNT(u.user_id), 0), 2)::double precision AS "Push opt-in share (%)" FROM (VALUES ('A'), ('B')) AS g(group_name) LEFT JOIN offline_users u ON (g.group_name = 'A' AND $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${a_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${a_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${a_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${a_country:sqlstring}) AND (${a_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${a_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${a_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${a_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${a_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${a_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${a_test:sqlstring})) OR (g.group_name = 'B' AND $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${b_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${b_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${b_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${b_country:sqlstring}) AND (${b_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${b_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${b_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${b_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${b_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${b_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${b_test:sqlstring})) GROUP BY g.group_name ORDER BY g.group_name

panels.title: Users in both groups
panels.description: Distinct synthetic users who match both filter sets in the shared UTC install range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users in both groups" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${a_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${a_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${a_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${a_country:sqlstring}) AND (${a_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${a_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${a_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${a_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${a_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${a_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${a_test:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${b_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${b_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${b_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${b_country:sqlstring}) AND (${b_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${b_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${b_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${b_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${b_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${b_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${b_test:sqlstring})

panels.title: First-day edits by onboarding goal
panels.description: Association, not a cause of churn. Group A and B are independently filtered and may overlap; Group users is the full selected group size.

targets.rawSql: SELECT group_name AS "Group", onboarding_goal AS "Goal", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users", SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY group_name)::integer AS "Group users", ROUND(AVG(ai_edits_first_day), 2)::double precision AS "Mean first-day edits" FROM (SELECT 'A' AS group_name, u.user_id, u.onboarding_goal, u.ai_edits_first_day, u.photos_imported, u.push_opt_in, u.acquisition_channel, u.platform, u.country FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${a_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${a_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${a_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${a_country:sqlstring}) AND (${a_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${a_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${a_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${a_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${a_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${a_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${a_test:sqlstring}) UNION ALL SELECT 'B' AS group_name, u.user_id, u.onboarding_goal, u.ai_edits_first_day, u.photos_imported, u.push_opt_in, u.acquisition_channel, u.platform, u.country FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${b_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${b_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${b_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${b_country:sqlstring}) AND (${b_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${b_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${b_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${b_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${b_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${b_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${b_test:sqlstring})) cohorts GROUP BY group_name, onboarding_goal ORDER BY group_name, onboarding_goal

panels.title: Imported photos and push preference
panels.description: First-day behavior in synthetic profiles. Group A and B are independently filtered and may overlap; Group users is the full selected group size.

targets.rawSql: SELECT group_name AS "Group", push_opt_in AS "Push opt-in", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users", SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY group_name)::integer AS "Group users", ROUND(AVG(photos_imported), 2)::double precision AS "Mean photos imported" FROM (SELECT 'A' AS group_name, u.user_id, u.onboarding_goal, u.ai_edits_first_day, u.photos_imported, u.push_opt_in, u.acquisition_channel, u.platform, u.country FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${a_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${a_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${a_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${a_country:sqlstring}) AND (${a_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${a_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${a_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${a_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${a_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${a_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${a_test:sqlstring}) UNION ALL SELECT 'B' AS group_name, u.user_id, u.onboarding_goal, u.ai_edits_first_day, u.photos_imported, u.push_opt_in, u.acquisition_channel, u.platform, u.country FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${b_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${b_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${b_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${b_country:sqlstring}) AND (${b_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${b_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${b_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${b_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${b_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${b_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${b_test:sqlstring})) cohorts GROUP BY group_name, push_opt_in ORDER BY group_name, push_opt_in

panels.description: Group size shown; bands are descriptive, not model thresholds. Group A and B are independently filtered and may overlap; Group users is the full selected group size.

u.ai_edits_first_day, u.photos_imported, u.push_opt_in, u.acquisition_channel, u.platform, u.country FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${b_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${b_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${b_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${b_country:sqlstring}) AND (${b_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = panels.title: Cohort composition by platform and country
panels.description: No feature importance or SHAP until the external owner supplies explanations. Group A and B are independently filtered and may overlap; Group users is the full selected group size.

targets.rawSql: SELECT group_name AS "Group", platform AS "Platform", country AS "Country", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users", SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY group_name)::integer AS "Group users" FROM (SELECT 'A' AS group_name, u.user_id, u.onboarding_goal, u.ai_edits_first_day, u.photos_imported, u.push_opt_in, u.acquisition_channel, u.platform, u.country FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${a_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${a_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${a_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${a_country:sqlstring}) AND (${a_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${a_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${a_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${a_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${a_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${a_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${a_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${a_test:sqlstring}) UNION ALL SELECT 'B' AS group_name, u.user_id, u.onboarding_goal, u.ai_edits_first_day, u.photos_imported, u.push_opt_in, u.acquisition_channel, u.platform, u.country FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND (${b_platform:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.platform = ${b_platform:sqlstring}) AND (${b_country:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.country = ${b_country:sqlstring}) AND (${b_channel:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.acquisition_channel = ${b_channel:sqlstring}) AND (${b_goal:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.onboarding_goal = ${b_goal:sqlstring}) AND (${b_flow:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR u.flow = ${b_flow:sqlstring}) AND (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${b_test:sqlstring} = '__no_test__' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') = '') OR u.ab_test = ${b_test:sqlstring})) cohorts GROUP BY group_name, platform, country ORDER BY group_name, "Users" DESC
